cases.Animal_Lab_ID: skip: laboratory sample identifier (not unique even — re-used across distinct cases)
cases.Event: skip: per-year serial number of the ministry's case report; carries no meaning beyond the date order
cases.Date: chart-years, chart-mix, chart-season, chart-heat, chart-rheat, chart-rshare, chart-lineage, kpi:total, kpi:last_year, kpi:trend12, insight:record, insight:trend12, insight:dogs, insight:season, insight:waves, map:map-main
cases.LinkToTest: skip: URL of the per-case lab/report PDF on gov.il — a document link, no aggregate meaning
cases.LinkToMre: skip: URL of an additional report document, 37% empty
cases.Year: skip: redundant with Date (the page derives the year from Date; Year is set on rows with no date, which are dropped)
cases.SpeciesNameHeb: chart-years, chart-species, chart-mix, chart-rsp, insight:dogs, map:map-main
cases.Species: chart-lineage, insight:lineage — virus genetic lineage code (VII, VIIA, VIIB, I …); whitespace normalized
cases.LocationNotSettlementHeb: chart-locations, map:map-main — named site used when no settlement is given
cases.x: map:map-main — Web-Mercator (EPSG:3857) easting, converted to longitude
cases.y: map:map-main — Web-Mercator (EPSG:3857) northing, converted to latitude
